Conversion rate dropped as traffic quality decreased
Simultaneously, $2K/month bleeding into Advantage+ Shopping with 0.85 ROAS
Blended CPA dragged up by both factors
contributing_factors: Retargeting frequency too high (6.2 on cart abandoners)
3% Lookalike diluting the efficient 1% LAL results
